channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: 'We won't support those who destroy Judaism': Bnei Brak protests Eisenkot government
item.description:
Amid ongoing talks to form a government led by Gadi Eisenkot's bloc, messages were broadcast over loudspeakers in Bnei Brak opposing the possibility of haredi parties supporting such a government.
Among the slogans heard was: "We will not support those who seek to destroy Judaism."

item.title: Trump on Eisenkot: He and Netanyahu have very similar views
item.description: Trump says Gadi Eisenkot and Benjamin Netanyahu share similar policies after Eisenkot receives the mandate to form Israel's next government.

item.title: Disturbances in Lod: 11 suspects arrested
item.description:
Police arrested 11 suspects, including a woman and minors, following disturbances during a gathering of dozens of people in Lod. According to police, the suspects disobeyed officers' instructions and disrupted public order.
Police clarified that "contrary to reports that circulated, no stabbing occurred at the scene."

item.title: Rubio: Iran's demands outrageous, nuclear deal not close
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio says a deal with Iran remains out of reach, calling Tehran's demands unrealistic.

item.title: Terrorist armed with firebomb shot by IDF troops in northern Samaria, hit confirmed
item.description:
IDF troops operating Sunday evening in the Zababdeh area spotted a terrorist holding a firebomb and preparing to throw it at the soldiers.
According to the IDF Spokesperson's Unit, the troops opened fire at the terrorist to eliminate the threat, and a hit was confirmed.

item.title: Trump touts new 'Iron Gate' blockade on Iran: Very little gets in or out
item.description: Trump highlights a new task force targeting Iran's supply routes and warns of further strikes, as Iranian media report explosions on Qeshm Island.

item.title: The Left’s haredi draft stance was always 100% political
item.description: The arrests of yeshiva students were also a purely political tactic. Opinion.

item.title: IAF exercise to take place over Nahariya, explosions expected to be heard
item.description:
An Israel Air Force exercise will take place Monday at approximately 6:00 a.m. over Nahariya and the surrounding area.
During the exercise, aircraft will fly at low altitudes, and sounds of explosions will be heard. There is no security threat.

item.title: Secret deal between Liberman and haredim revealed
item.description: Yisrael Beytenu chair Avigdor Liberman denies report of draft concessions in secret talks with United Torah Judaism, calling it 'lies and fabrications.'

item.title: A 50-year-old man was seriously injured in a violent incident on HaTikva Street in Tel Aviv
item.description:
A 50-year-old man was seriously injured in a violent incident on HaTikva Street in Tel Aviv.
Magen David Adom (MDA) paramedics treated him at the scene before evacuating him to Ichilov Hospital in the city.

item.title: 45 Years of Fighting for Israel - Dr. Frager Insists: "It's bad, but it will get better"
item.description: As anti-Israel sentiment spreads across America's political divide, Dr. Joe Frager warns of the toughest climate in his 45 years of advocacy. But despite the growing hostility, he predicts a turning point: "It'll get worse before it gets better."

item.title: Police open fire on vehicle carrying illegal residents near Isawiya
item.description:
Jerusalem District police officers opened fire on a vehicle traveling toward Isawiya after the driver allegedly endangered their lives during an attempt to stop it. The vehicle's occupants were arrested, and four were taken to the hospital for medical treatment.
Police suspect that the vehicle was transporting illegal residents.

item.title: Israel slams Britain over 50-country initiative targeting Jerusalem with Gaza demands
item.description: In response to UK initiative calling for expanded aid to Gaza, Israel's Ambassador to the UN Danny Danon says, 'Instead of giving Israel a list of demands, it is time to demand the dismantling of Hamas.'

item.title: Urgent appeal seeks rabbinical oversight of hundreds of Jewish cemeteries in Ukraine
item.description: The Union of Ukrainian Expatriates warns that unauthorized construction and renovation work is damaging historic Jewish burial sites, calling for a central rabbinical authority to protect them.

item.title: Watch: Annual Shluchim Gala Banquet kicks off
item.description: Annual Chabad-Lubavitch International Conference of Shluchim kicks off gala banquet, attended by emissaries from around the world.

item.title: Jonathan Burkan: Israel must prepare to go its own way after Trump
item.description: Israel Justice Organization board member Jonathan Burkan tells Arutz Sheva Israel should build new alliances, strengthen weapons production, ahead of a possible shift in US relations.

item.title: “Dark Forces Are Trying to Divide Us": Warning Over U.S.-Israel Relations
item.description: During Solidarity Mission to Israel, David Bukzin Warns of Growing Political Divisions in America and Calls for a New Approach to Engaging Young People

item.title: Washington blinked. Now Israel enters the Blame Game
item.description: Vance is entitled to argue that the Iran war cost Republicans the election. But he should not be allowed to use those arguments to blame Israel and thereby bypass his administration’s own failed record. Opinion.

item.title: Three executed in Iran for anti-regime protests
item.description: Iran executes three men accused of taking part in January’s anti-regime protests; judiciary alleges they acted on behalf of Israel and US.

item.title: US offers $20 million reward for information on Iran's nuclear program
item.description: Washington offers up to $20 million and political asylum to anyone providing new intelligence on Iran’s nuclear facilities, equipment or personnel, as concerns grow over Tehran’s nuclear activities.

item.title: Trump says renewed attacks on Iran highly unlikely if talks show progress
item.description: US President Donald Trump said it is very unlikely that the US will resume its war against Iran if talks with Tehran continue.

item.title: Iran: Oil tanker hits naval mine and catches fire near Strait of Hormuz
item.description:
The Iranian Navy claimed that an oil tanker struck a naval mine and caught fire east of the Strait of Hormuz.
According to the Iranian military, the tanker was sailing in a prohibited area after switching off its identification systems and was operating in violation of regulations.

item.title: Iranian foreign minister threatens US: 'Choose war, and we will rain hellfire down on you'
item.description:
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi issued an ultimatum to the White House, calling on Washington to accept Tehran's demands, including an end to the war on all fronts. He said Iran's proposal remains on the table.
"Meet our demands and you will see the results. Or choose war, and see how our experienced and battle-ready fighters rain hellfire down on you," he threatened.

item.title: IDF finds Hezbollah weapons near UN posts in Lebanon
item.description: IDF troops uncover weapons stockpiles, Hezbollah military apartment 100 to 250 meters from UN posts in southern Lebanon.

item.title: Red alert at Kibbutz Nir Oz
item.description: The IDF Spokesperson's Unit reported that sirens were activated in the Nir Oz area. The circumstances of the incident are being investigated.

item.title: Thousands of Chabad emissaries from 111 countries gather in a display of strength at 770
item.description: Thousands of Chabad emissaries from 111 countries gathered outside 770 in Brooklyn for their traditional group photo, held in the shadow of the deadly Sydney Hanukkah attack last year that claimed 16 lives.

item.title: US Marine veteran says Israel and America must stand together against evil
item.description: Visiting Israel Benghazi veteran Mark Geist says the fight is ultimately one of good versus evil, calls for US-Israel unity, and credits Trump's leadership as essential to achieving peace in the Middle East.

item.title: IDF's 98th Division wraps up Judea and Samaria mission
item.description: Over 140 suspects apprehended, approximately 35 weapons located during operations by the Judea and Etzion Brigades.

item.title: It's official: Eisenkot receives mandate to form Israel’s next government
item.description: Israeli President Isaac Herzog tasks Yashar! chairman Gadi Eisenkot with forming a government, after 67 MKs recommended him.
